title: The Episode About Shamas Khan and Baizid Khan

blocks.text: With multiple faujdars killed, fear spreads outward and the court begins looking for indirect means to restrain Banda rather than relying only on force.
The emperor rejects dishonorable methods against the Guru’s household, yet he turns to Bhai Nand Lal as a trusted intermediary who may reach the Guru’s family with respect and persuasion.
Bhai Nand Lal is therefore the hinge between slaughter in the field and anxious counsel at court.
